parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing evidence is thin. Consensual same-sex conduct is not criminalised, and a 2023 hate-crime enhancement covers gender identity, though the dossier records no enforcement or prosecutions under it. No trans-specific offence, facility ban or documented border or custody practice appears. Same-sex marriage and adoption are resident-facing climate signals only. Legal gender change and the medical requirement are resident-facing and not counted. Against this, there is no general service-discrimination statute outside government employment, and recourse is limited, so a visitor refused service has little remedy. Border screening follows the governing state's rules, which the dossier does not describe, so I did not infer them. The 60-person Pride event shows a small organised community, not broad acceptance. Open questions on facilities, custody and detention are not established exposures. Structural signals are mildly positive, pulling the rating into the reduced-risk band rather than higher.
